name: Kimberley
routeRole: Historically documented Shosholoza Meyl stop; featured tourism place
story: Kimberley gives the simulated journey a chance to explore how diamond mining shaped a place and the lives connected to it. A traveller can save the Big Hole and its museum for a separate visit.
visitorNote: The Big Hole is an attraction, not the railway station. Transfer arrangements and entry details require a fresh check.
